dog.description_text:
🩶 Meet Principessa! 🤍

Beautiful Principessa is a lovely 2 year old girl with a soft grey coat and the sweetest little white bib. She’s a naturally timid girl who takes a little time to feel comfortable, but underneath that initial shyness is a true sweetheart just waiting to blossom.

In her foster home, Principessa even discovered the joys of cuddling! Sadly, the transition to our adoption center has brought back some of her more reserved ways, and she’s once again waiting for someone willing to give her the time and patience she needs.

She does wonderfully with other cats and would love a home with a feline friend to help her feel comfortable. More than anything, she needs a calm, loving environment where she can settle in at her own pace without any pressure.

Principessa may not be the cat who runs up to greet you on day one, but give her a chance, and you may just discover the sweetest little cuddlebug.

She’s waiting for someone to see the love behind her shy exterior. Could that someone be you? 🐾🤍
dog.name: Principessa
